+import click
+import pytest
+
+
+FIRST = "CLICK_SEM_FIRST"
+SECOND = "CLICK_SEM_SECOND"
+AUTO = "CLICK_SEM_MODE"
+
+
+def _parse(monkeypatch, values, *, args=(), default_map=None, **option_kwargs):
+    for name in (FIRST, SECOND, AUTO):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
+    for name, value in values.items():
+        monkeypatch.setenv(name, value)
+    settings = dict(
+        flag_value="active",
+        type=click.UNPROCESSED,
+        default="declared",
+        envvar=(FIRST, SECOND),
+    )
+    settings.update(option_kwargs)
+    cmd = click.Command("cli", params=[click.Option(["--mode"], **settings)])
+    with cmd.make_context(
+        "cli", list(args), auto_envvar_prefix="CLICK_SEM", default_map=default_map
+    ) as ctx:
+        return ctx.params["mode"], ctx.get_parameter_source("mode")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "values,expected",
+    [
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "yes"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "active"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "on"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: "", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "active"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: " OFF ", AUTO: "yes"}, False),
+        ({FIRST: "no", SECOND: "active", AUTO: "yes"}, False),
+        ({FIRST: "active", SECOND: "no"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: " TRUE ", SECOND: "no"}, "active"),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "0"}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_semantic_env_candidates(monkeypatch, values, expected):
+    value, source = _parse(monkeypatch, values)
+    assert value == expected
+    assert source is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "values,option_kwargs,default_map,expected,source",
+    [
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "invalid"}, {}, None,
+         "declared", click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "invalid"}, {},
+         {"mode": "mapped"}, "mapped", click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "invalid"}, {},
+         {"mode": None}, None, click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "invalid", AUTO: "yes"},
+         {"allow_from_autoenv": False}, None,
+         "declared", click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "yes", AUTO: "no"},
+         {"allow_from_autoenv": False}, None,
+         "active", click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT),
+        ({FIRST: "invalid", AUTO: "yes"}, {"envvar": FIRST}, None,
+         "active", click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT),
+    ],
+)
+def test_semantic_env_fallback(monkeypatch, values, option_kwargs,
+                               default_map, expected, source):
+    assert _parse(
+        monkeypatch, values, default_map=default_map, **option_kwargs
+    ) == (expected, source)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw", ["invalid", "no", "active"])
+def test_semantic_env_commandline(monkeypatch, raw):
+    assert _parse(
+        monkeypatch, {FIRST: raw, SECOND: "yes", AUTO: "no"},
+        args=("--mode",), default_map={"mode": "mapped"}
+    ) == ("active", click.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw", ["false", "0", " bar ", ""])
+def test_semantic_env_exact_match(monkeypatch, raw):
+    values = {FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: raw, AUTO: "no"}
+    expected = False if raw == "" else raw
+    assert _parse(monkeypatch, values, flag_value=raw) == (
+        expected, click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "option_kwargs,expected",
+    [
+        ({"flag_value": 42, "type": None}, 42),
+        ({"flag_value": "active", "type": None}, "active"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_semantic_env_inferred_types(monkeypatch, option_kwargs, expected):
+    assert _parse(
+        monkeypatch, {FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "yes"}, **option_kwargs
+    ) == (expected, click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT)
+
+
+def test_ordinary_env_selection_unchanged(monkeypatch):
+    assert _parse(
+        monkeypatch, {FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "yes", AUTO: "fallback"},
+        is_flag=False, flag_value=None, type=str
+    ) == ("invalid", click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT)
+
+
+def test_boolean_env_selection_unchanged(monkeypatch):
+    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter):
+        _parse(
+            monkeypatch, {FIRST: "invalid", SECOND: "yes", AUTO: "yes"},
+            is_flag=True, flag_value=True, type=bool, default=False
+        )
+    assert _parse(
+        monkeypatch, {FIRST: "no", SECOND: "yes", AUTO: "yes"},
+        is_flag=True, flag_value=True, type=bool, default=False
+    ) == (False, click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT)

spec.question:
Make environment-variable fallback for Click's non-boolean flags depend on whether each candidate supplies a usable activation value, rather than stopping at the first non-empty string. Consider explicit envvar names in declaration order, treating a single name as one candidate. Missing or empty values decline the candidate. A raw value exactly equal to flag_value activates the flag, retaining the existing exact-match rule; otherwise, recognized boolean strings supply flag_value for true or False for false, before normal type conversion. An unrecognized string declines that candidate and permits the next name to be considered. An accepted false value must stop selection, even if a later variable would activate the flag.

If every explicit candidate declines, consider the automatic environment variable when the context enables it and allow_from_autoenv permits it, using the same acceptance rules. If that candidate also declines or is unavailable, retain normal default_map and declared-default fallback. Record ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT only when an environment candidate is accepted; default-map and declared-default provenance must remain unchanged when all candidates decline. Keep command-line precedence, boolean-flag selection, ordinary value-option selection, and existing type conversion unchanged.

Deliver a unified diff against the production files, without changing tests.

If all explicitly named candidates decline, try the automatic environment variable when enabled, then normal defaults. Implement this in src/click/core.py around Parameter.resolve_envvar_value, Option.resolve_envvar_value, and Option.value_from_envvar, with tests in tests/test_options.py covering ordered candidates, automatic-prefix fallback, allow_from_autoenv=False, command-line precedence, and ParameterSource.
